# Implementation Plan: Multimodal Enterprise RAG UI

**Branch**: `002-multimodal-enterprise-rag` | **Date**: 2025-10-14 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-multimodal-enterprise-rag/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command based on comprehensive technical research.

## Summary

The Multimodal Enterprise RAG UI is a modern web-based interface that provides users with a two-panel layout for document management and intelligent search. The system supports drag-and-drop file uploads for PDF, TXT, JPG, PNG, MP3, and MP4 files, processes them in real-time, and enables natural language querying with comprehensive answers, source citations, knowledge graph exploration, and performance evaluation metrics.

**Technical Approach**: React 18 + TypeScript frontend consuming existing FastAPI backend services with WebSocket real-time updates, responsive design for desktop/tablet/mobile, and comprehensive error handling.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.0+ with React 18.2+
**Primary Dependencies**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, react-dropzone, vis-network, framer-motion, Axios
**Storage**: Existing backend PostgreSQL, Qdrant (vector), Neo4j (graph), Redis (cache)
**Testing**: Jest + React Testing Library + Cypress for E2E
**Target Platform**: Web application (desktop, tablet, mobile browsers)
**Project Type**: Single-page web application with real-time features
**Performance Goals**: <2s query response time, <5min file processing, <1s graph rendering for 500 nodes
**Constraints**: 50MB file size limit, 5GB user storage quota, 99% uptime with 2-hour monthly maintenance windows
**Scale/Scope**: 50 concurrent users, 10+ file types, real-time processing with WebSocket updates

## Constitution Check

**Constitution Compliance Assessment**:

✅ **I. Evaluation-First Development**:

✅ **III. Multi-Agent Orchestration**:

✅ **IV. Hybrid Search**:
- Integrates with existing vector, graph, and keyword search capabilities

✅ **V. Enterprise Security**:
- JWT-based authentication with role-based access control

✅ **VI. Performance & Scalability**:
- Performance targets aligned with service level agreements
- Real-time updates via WebSocket without blocking UI operations
- Responsive design supports varying device capabilities

✅ **VII. Observability**:
- Error boundaries and comprehensive error handling
- Performance monitoring integration with existing analytics
- User feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement

| Graph Visualization | HIGH | Interactive knowledge graph with filtering and layout algorithms |
| Responsive Design | MEDIUM | Mobile-first approach with breakpoint strategy |
| Testing | MEDIUM | Unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests required |

**Overall Assessment**: **MEDIUM COMPLEXITY** - Appropriate for enterprise application with real-time features and multimodal capabilities. All complexity is justified by user requirements and no simpler alternatives would meet the specification.
